Other than these terms and conditions, bidder will be rejected if not submitting any document which is mentioned in the Bid document. 42) Specifications for Lyophilizer 1. System should be bench-top/pilot-scale suitable for lyophilization of stem cell secretome, biologics, extracellular vesicles (EVs), proteins, peptides, serum pro ducts, and temperature-sensitive biomolecules. 2. The system should have ultra-low condenser temperature capability of –100° C to –120°C with cascade refrigeration technology and dual independent compr essors. 3. The refrigeration system should preferably be CFC-free and environmentally compliant. 4. The system must be compatible with aqueous as well as low-concentration or ganic solvent-based formulations. 5. Ice formation capacity should be minimum 4 liters/4 kg per 24 hrs or higher. 6. The offered system should preferably have · Dual refrigeration auto cascade system · ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / CE certification · Multi drying chamber compatibility including clear drying chamber, heat ed drying chamber, and manifold drying chamber · Compatible vacuum pump capacity around 196–283 LPM or better 7. Condenser capacity should be minimum 6 kg or higher for rapid moisture cap

ture and improved freeze-drying efficiency. 8. Chamber volume should be minimum 5 liters or higher. 9. System should be provided with minimum four (04) stainless steel shelves/trays with uniform temperature distribution. 10. Each tray spacing should be minimum 70 mm for placement of glass vials, s erum bottles, cryovials, and stem cell secretome containers. 11. Shelf temperature uniformity should be ±1°C or better. 12. System should have vacuum capability of ≤ 0.001 mbar with Pirani and cap acitance manometer vacuum sensors. 13. Vacuum control should be automatic and programmable for each step of th e lyophilization cycle. 14. The system should have a minimum 7-inch or larger color touchscreen PID Microprocessor controllerwith graphical display of: · Shelf temperature · Condenser temperature · Product temperature · Vacuum level · Cycle duration · Pressure trend graphs 15. System should support automatic freeze-drying cycle including: · Freezing · Primary drying · Secondary drying · Vacuum control · Automatic defrosting · Venting 16. System should have one-touch start/stop/vent/defrost operation. 17. System should have integrated hot gas defrost system for rapid condenser defrosting. 18. System should have automatic anti-suck back/non-return valve to prevent v acuum pump oil backflow into condenser chamber. 19. Multiport acrylic system should be provided with the instument. 20. Acrylic/glass chamber diameter should be minimum 250 mm or higher.

21. System should have minimum 8 drying ports/manifold connections with: · Four (04) x 500 mL drying flasks · Four (04) x 250 mL drying flasks 22 . System should also support vial drying/tray drying applications. 23. System should have inbuilt pressure control valve and vacuum regulation sy stem. 24. System should include product temperature probe/PT-100 sensors for valida tion of product temperature during lyophilization. 25. System should have real-time data acquisition and recording facility with US B/Ethernet export. 26. System should have low-noise operation not exceeding 52dB. 27. System power requirement should be compatible with 220V 50Hz / 230V 50 Hz single-phase Indian power supply. 28. System should be supplied complete with: · Vacuum pump · Oil mist filter · Connecting hoses · Vacuum grease (if applicable) · Manifold assembly · Standard accessories required for operation 29. Vendor should provide: · IQ/OQ documentation · Calibration certificates · User training · Installation support · Minimum 1-year comprehensive warranty 30. Preference may be given to systems specifically designed for biologics, ste m cell products, extracellular vehicles (EVs), protein therapeutics, and advance d research applications. 1. . 13. System should be bench-top/pilot-scale suitable for lyophilization of stem cell secretome, biologics, extracellular vesicles (EVs), proteins, peptides, serum pro ducts, and temperature-sensitive biomolecules. 2. The system should have ultra-low condenser temperature capability of –100° C to –120°C with cascade refrigeration technology and dual independent compr essors. 3. The refrigeration system should preferably be CFC-free and environmentally compliant. 4. The system must be compatible with aqueous as well as low-concentration or ganic solvent-based formulations. 5. Ice formation capacity should be minimum 4 liters/4 kg per 24 hrs or higher. 6. The offered system should preferably have · Dual refrigeration auto cascade system · ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / CE certification · Multi drying chamber compatibility including clear drying chamber, heat ed drying chamber, and manifold drying chamber · Compatible vacuum pump capacity around 196–283 LPM or better 7. Condenser capacity should be minimum 6 kg or higher for rapid moisture cap

ture and improved freeze-drying efficiency. 8. Chamber volume should be minimum 5 liters or higher. 9. System should be provided with minimum four (04) stainless steel shelves/trays with uniform temperature distribution. 10. Each tray spacing should be minimum 70 mm for placement of glass vials, s erum bottles, cryovials, and stem cell secretome containers. 11. Shelf temperature uniformity should be ±1°C or better. 12. System should have vacuum capability of ≤ 0.001 mbar with Pirani and cap acitance manometer vacuum sensors. 13. Vacuum control should be automatic and programmable for each step of th e lyophilization cycle. 14. The system should have a minimum 7-inch or larger color touchscreen PID Microprocessor controllerwith graphical display of: · Shelf temperature · Condenser temperature · Product temperature · Vacuum level · Cycle duration · Pressure trend graphs 15. System should support automatic freeze-drying cycle including: · Freezing · Primary drying · Secondary drying · Vacuum control · Automatic defrosting · Venting 16. System should have one-touch start/stop/vent/defrost operation. 17. System should have integrated hot gas defrost system for rapid condenser defrosting. 18. System should have automatic anti-suck back/non-return valve to prevent v acuum pump oil backflow into condenser chamber. 19. Multiport acrylic system should be provided with the instument. 20. Acrylic/glass chamber diameter should be minimum 250 mm or higher.

21. System should have minimum 8 drying ports/manifold connections with: · Four (04) x 500 mL drying flasks · Four (04) x 250 mL drying flasks 22 . System should also support vial drying/tray drying applications. 23. System should have inbuilt pressure control valve and vacuum regulation sy stem. 24. System should include product temperature probe/PT-100 sensors for valida tion of product temperature during lyophilization. 25. System should have real-time data acquisition and recording facility with US B/Ethernet export. 26. System should have low-noise operation not exceeding 52dB. 27. System power requirement should be compatible with 220V 50Hz / 230V 50 Hz single-phase Indian power supply. 28. System should be supplied complete with: · Vacuum pump · Oil mist filter · Connecting hoses · Vacuum grease (if applicable) · Manifold assembly · Standard accessories required for operation 29. Vendor should provide: · IQ/OQ documentation · Calibration certificates · User training · Installation support · Minimum 1-year comprehensive warranty 30.
